highlights.title: See how much of each AI account is left
highlights.text: A Claude or Codex sign-in on Apps & accounts shows its 5-hour and weekly limits, like "93% left · resets 22:29". A bar turns amber when it runs low.

highlights.title: Check an account's limits when you want
highlights.text: Check now reads the latest numbers, at most once a minute and never by itself. The model badge on a bot's avatar shows them too.

highlights.title: See when a job is done
highlights.text: A job's last reply gets a Done mark after the bot's name, or what checked it: Checked, Partly checked, Check failed or Not checked.

highlights.title: Approve right from the reply
highlights.text: When a bot asks for your OK, Approve and Change… sit under its reply. Approve tells it "Approved, go ahead."

highlights.title: Find any app in one list
highlights.text: Another app on Apps & accounts lists Composio apps and tool servers together, one row per app, with how it signs in.

fixes: Bots find their notes by meaning, not just exact words, when the space has an OpenAI key or a local Ollama embedding model.
Bots can quote documents you put in a space's docs folder (Markdown, text or PDF), with the page for PDFs.
Dev mode offers a modern-web skill once for web projects, so bots follow Google Chrome's Modern Web Guidance.
